sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: One row, one figure: Contoso's closed shops were open for an average of 2,257.4375 days — 6.18 years — measured as elapsed calendar time from each shop's opening day to its closing day, averaged over all 16 physical premises that have ceased trading, each counting once. WHAT THE FIGURE DOES NOT INCLUDE: the 57 shops still trading, which have no closing date and therefore no finished lifetime to average (including them would measure age-so-far, a different quantity); the online store, which has never closed; and any sense of hours actually open for business, which this bundle does not record. No date window was applied — every store that has ever closed is in it, with closings running 2013-12-05 to 2019-11-03 and the openings behind them from 2005-04-04. The individual lives ranged from 937 days to 4,259 days, so the single average hides a wide spread.
